entities.note: 4x4 colour-11 square at rows 13-16, cols 30-33 whose two bottom-middle pixels are transparent ('feet'); it is moved only by running the program, never by direct clicks

hollow colour-11 outline at rows 33-37, cols 29-34 (open at the top, with two 'feet' pixels at row 36) directly below the avatar in the same column; its 4x4 cavity rows 33-36, cols 30-33 is where the avatar must stop = 20 px below its start

ten 3-px bars in the black program strip (rows 41-47, cols 19-43), five columns of two: a horizontal bar on row 42 (cols 20-22, 25-27, 30-32, 35-37, 40-42) and a vertical bar on rows 44-46 (cols 21, 26, 31, 36, 41); grey(5) = ON, colour 1 = OFF; initially columns 1 and 3 are ON/ON, the rest OFF/OFF. Clicking anywhere in a bar's 5x3 slot cell flips it
9x9 colour-9 disc at rows 51-59, cols 32-40 below the strip, joined to it by a black line; turns colour 10 for one frame when pressed and runs the program
9x8-cell checkerboard of 4-px cells (colours 5/4) at rows 9-40, cols 14-49 inside a black-bordered panel (rows 8-47, cols 13-50): the avatar moves on this 4-px lattice
black frame around the panel, the black program strip background (rows 41-47) and the black connector line to the run button; clicking them does nothing
row 1, cols 1-61: colour-9 bar that loses 1 px from its RIGHT end (revealing colour 3) per processed click; 61 clicks total

rules.note: flips that one bar between grey(5)=ON and colour 1=OFF; each column encodes an instruction: horizontal ON only = move left 4, vertical ON only = move right 4, both ON = move down 4, both OFF = do nothing; costs 1 click

runs the program: avatar reset to its start, then columns 1..5 execute one per frame (4 px per move instruction); if it does not finish exactly in the ghost's cavity it snaps back to its start (rows 13-16); the run button flashes colour 10; costs 1 click
clicks on the checkerboard, the avatar, the ghost, the panel or outside it change nothing but still cost 1 click

goal.note: a run must leave the colour-11 avatar exactly filling the ghost outline (rows 33-36, cols 30-33) with the same size/rotation/colour: net displacement (+20 rows, 0 cols) = all five columns set to both-ON (down 4); then avatar and ghost flash colour 14 and the level ends. Initial program = down, nop, down, nop, nop -> 6 toggle clicks + 1 run
